projectDescription: An open-source, browser-based real-time implementation of the Mafia party game with rooms, role assignment, night actions, voting, narrator controls, and optional in-game chat — built with React, TypeScript, Vercel serverless functions, and Supabase.
keyFeatures: Real-time multiplayer rooms with 6-digit room codes and up to 20 players
Automatic role assignment: Mafia, Villager, Doctor, Detective, Silencer, and custom roles
Narrator role with full game-state visibility to guide rounds
Night action system: kill, heal, investigate, and silence — all server-resolved
Live voting with automatic tie-breaking and elimination tracking
Graveyard chat for eliminated players and Mafia team chat during night phases
Casual (role-only) mode for in-person play with app-assisted role assignment
Player-specific state projection — clients never receive other players' secret roles
Row-Level Security on Supabase; service-role key stays server-side only
Session persistence via localStorage with automatic rejoin on page reload
Automated room cleanup via Vercel Cron at 03:00 UTC daily
